_doc: THE keystone — the single source of truth for the WarpOS agent roster, per ADR-0007 (agent-system org rewrite). Each role carries: identity (name·call_sign·true_name·home·tier·kind), the model map (provider·model·effort·fallback), dispatch authority (dispatchable_by·dispatches·build_chain), review semantics (review_scope·binding_verdict·claude_pinned), multiplicity, the target spec path, the named enforcer, and the rewrite disposition (status·was). Routers + enforcers READ FROM HERE so a rename/swap is ONE edit (catalog.js·providers.js·state.js·org-roles.js·team-guard·dispatch-route-guard·gauntlet-verify + the RESULT schemas are rewired to derive from this — staged migration, gated by scan:role-parity + scan:dispatch-routing-parity). ED-024 (ADR-0010): the REPORTING-LINE STRUCTURE is now SINGLE-SOURCED HERE — `home`/`sub_home` (which department/pod a role reports into) + `dispatchable_by` (its managers) ARE the org reporting structure; scan:role-parity verifies them against the INDEPENDENT on-disk spec tree (department-dir = home, pod-dir = sub_home, frontmatter name = role id) so the check is non-vacuous (Trap-A). org-map.json's `domains{}` roster was the old structural view; it is now a non-authoritative legacy husk (E8 removes it with the routing-role rename). org-map.role_registry points here. DO NOT add a role here as 'built' (status live) unless its spec resolves under .claude/agents/.
supersedes_note: ED-024 (ADR-0010): this registry's home/sub_home/dispatchable_by SUPERSEDE org-map.json's `domains{}` reporting-line view as the single structural source (verified vs the spec tree by scan:role-parity). org-map.json v0.1 is kept for its `gauntlets`/`routing`/`claims_boundary` views + a now-legacy `domains{}` husk E8 finishes removing. ADR-0007 + ADR-0010 are the decision records.

model_policy._doc: ADR-0007 + operator rules (2026-06-04). Reviewers are ≥-capable AND on a DIFFERENT provider than the doer they review (cross-provider-flagship 'smarter'); doers & fixers share the doer model. Effort: `max` is reserved for VERY BIG projects AND only the top face (alpha) — everything else caps at the model's high-water mark; gpt-5.5 ceiling is xhigh; gemini has no effort flag (thinking always-on). INTENTIONAL CHAIN (operator 2026-06-16, memory feedback_model_opus48max_not_fable): Opus-4.8 is the SHIPPED top model and `fable`/`claude-fable-5` is NOT the top default (explicitly rejected); `max` is alpha-only; the senior-judgment tier (β + the three directors) runs at xhigh — the opus high-water mark below max; the deliver-face conductors (γ/δ/ε), leads, builders, and fixers run at high; tool roles scale down (test-runner medium, skeleton-builder null). For in-process roles (Agent-tool spawn) effort is documented intent (the harness sets depth operationally); for CLI-routed roles (dispatch-agent.js reviewers) effort is live. This chain is machine-enforced by scan:model-chain (scripts/checks/model-chain.js, ED-058).

security_2nd_pass._doc: the mandated 2nd-GPT security pass (Gemini corpus-diverse + OpenAI jailbreak-tuned) — a dispatch behavior (runProvider opts.provider override), not a separate role.

carve_outs._doc: Recorded so a future parity scan does NOT 'fix' these as violations (ADR-0007).
carve_outs.claude_pinned_visual_review: design-quality + visual-review are pinned to Claude because their judgment is VISUAL (Playwright-MCP); independence is the BINDING VERDICT (they grade, don't author), not provider diversity. A sanctioned exception to cross-provider-diversity.
carve_outs.cross_provider_is_a_dispatch_property: A reviewer carries its provider assignment in this registry — diversity is a dispatch property of the Reviewer, not a separate agent type.

tiers.face: Alex's mode-selected faces — one identity, singletons. NOT separate org titles.
tiers.lead: owns a function/pod — singleton; scales by fanning out workers, never by cloning itself.
tiers.worker: Builder/Reviewer/Fixer — multi-instance fan-out, each in its own worktree, each a binding verdict.

alpha._note: the top — the sole `max`. Runs as the harness session; catalog effort is documented intent (operationally set by /effort).

beta._note: model bump does NOT fix P-043 canned verdicts — the real-per-consult-reasoning + UNREASONED/abstain honesty contract is a separate tracked build item (Task #6).

epsilon._note: sprint conductor — reads the hook-point registry {role,step,condition,mode,order} and runs plan→design→build→gauntlet→release→retro; managers self-dispatch their phases. INHERITS δ's heartbeat + 30-min-stale circuit-breaker (ε runs long like δ). DESIGN-LOCKED, build in Phase D.

product-lead._note: authors PRD/stories/AC; co-authors the mockup with design-lead.

design-lead.dispatch_path: subprocess-consult (dispatch-agent.js / codex exec) — NOT an in-process Claude teammate
design-lead._note: RULE 4 — the one product role on gpt-5.5 (operator: best at product design/UX/flows). Owns UI/UX authoring + mockups; routine microcopy from _knowledge/copy. AUTHORS — judged by quality-lead's design-quality (no self-judging).

quality-lead._note: broadened: functional + UI/UX experience; dispatches QA Reviewers. tools:Agent required to fan out QA-Reviewer personas.

qa-reviewer.review_scope: traceability (the 6 req-reviewer checks: behavior↔req↔code↔test · contract-propagation · risk-class agreement · drift hygiene) + integrity (compliance: COPY.md exact-match · hallucinated_dep · 5 violation types · cross-provider) + functional (the 13 qa personas: scan 1-7 + analyze 8-13 + flow_traces/data_flows/state_diffs)
qa-reviewer._note: ABSORBS req-reviewer + compliance as review SCOPES (pod reviewers = code-quality only). Port Tier-3 verbatim: holdout-fixture is the reviewer's, the 6 traceability checks + BLOCKING rule (risk_class_disagreement / contract_propagation_missed override the panel) are req-reviewer's, COPY exact-match + hallucinated_dep are compliance's. tools:Agent for parallel persona dispatch.

design-quality.review_scope: design-tokens · component-usage · visual-hierarchy · mobile-responsive · accessibility · design-handoff (cross-domain: app-design Product + web-design Growth)
design-quality._note: CARVE-OUT: Claude-pinned (visual judgment). W1 gap: built but must be WIRED into γ/δ (zero new machinery) — cheapest Tier-4 win.

visual-review._note: CARVE-OUT: Claude-pinned (Playwright-MCP). dedup scope vs design-quality during build.

director-of-engineering._note: DoE-as-ORCHESTRATOR (re-ratify with η+β at build): dispatches the pods, inherits γ's dispatch independence; invariant = no self-judging + cannot override a FAIL; gauntlet roster registry-FIXED, not DoE-chosen.

frontend-builder._note: collapse the 01-adhoc ↔ 02-oneshot duplicate into ONE spec (mode-agnostic).

frontend-reviewer.review_scope: code-quality only (Check-7 7A-7G + holdout-fixture step-expectations/golden.json + CWD/branch pre-check). Traceability/integrity moved to qa-reviewer.
frontend-reviewer._note: cross-provider vs the Claude FE builder. Port the holdout-fixture (the #1 anti-hallucination gate) verbatim.

frontend-fixer._note: fix-one-brief ≤3 attempts; Fixer authors → frontend-reviewer RE-RUNS after every fix.

security-reviewer.review_scope: OWASP · authn/z · injection · secrets · attack-chain-correlator (3 MEDIUM → CRITICAL) · prompt-injection-prober
security-reviewer.scan_mode: ALL deterministic — NO LLM reasoning (a security guarantee that must not erode)
security-reviewer._note: REPLACES the redteam agent. THREE providers best-of-each, FIRED in order (E-DISPATCH-PERFECT-001 W1): gemini corpus-diverse (primary) → gpt-5.5 jailbreak (second_pass) → claude-opus-4-8 final (third_pass). dispatch-agent.js is the dispatch CONSUMER of second_pass/third_pass — it fires each pass with a provider override and writes one provider-stamped completion record per pass; any-FAIL holds. Port verbatim: deterministic scan-mode, attack-chain-correlator, prompt-injection-prober.

director-of-growth._note: dept Marketing → Growth (research + message + conversion + paid); owns message coherence.

research-lead._note: audience research → shared _knowledge/audience (segment-level, source-attributed, confidence-scored, no PII). Moved out of Product into Growth.

copy-lead._note: owns voice + high-leverage copy; seeds _knowledge/copy; authors COPY.md contract for builders.

marketing-lead._note: paid media · campaigns · EQ scoring (SCALE/TEST/SKIP) · LTV:CAC.

ops-analyst._note: S-7 (PLAN §9.4): renamed learner→ops-analyst + re-homed _system→president (President's office). Cross-cycle learning / between-cycle auditor loop; cross-provider meta-review (sees Claude builder/reviewer shared blind spots). Legacy ids learner/auditor resolve via role-aliases; REASONING_LEARNER honored via readReasoningEnv legacy-name pattern.

skeleton-builder._note: S-7 (PLAN §9.4): renamed stub-scaffold→skeleton-builder + re-homed _system→engineering. Skeleton stub regen on Sonnet (not Haiku) for signature fidelity. effort null to match live dispatch (catalog DEFAULT_EFFORT_PER_ROLE). build_chain (goes through dispatch-claude.js). Legacy id stub-scaffold resolves via role-aliases.

cabinet._note: S-7 (PLAN §9.4): the registered freeform cross-provider second-opinion / outside-counsel role (President's office), collapsing the W-4 pseudo-roles advisor + consult into ONE registered role. NO strict output schema (freeform) — dispatch-agent.js FREEFORM_ROLES skips envelope validation so a freeform reply doesn't trip the review-envelope validator or distort review-role telemetry. Legacy ids advisor/consult resolve via role-aliases.
